<compartment start="70" end="78" title="Preserved PDF rotation before OCR" episode_type="investigation,bug" importance="61">
<p1>
QuillOCR misread several rotated county tax forms after the Poppler path landed. The symptom was columns transposed only on pages using JBIG2 image masks. The raster path in workers/pdf/rasterize.ts trusted pdfimages output, but pdfimages dropped page rotation for those masks; Tesseract then deskewed from the wrong orientation. Fixed by reading rotation from pdfinfo before rasterization and applying it in normalizePageBitmap(). Added fixtures under test/fixtures/county-tax-rotated/. Commit f0a6d2b.
</p1>
<p2>
QuillOCR now reads page rotation from pdfinfo before rasterizing Poppler image output, fixing rotated JBIG2-mask tax forms.
</p2>
<p3>
PDF page rotation is captured before OCR rasterization so Tesseract sees the correct orientation.
</p3>
<p4>pdfinfo rotation; JBIG2 masks; normalizePageBitmap</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* QuillOCR cannot rely on pdfimages output for page rotation when Poppler emits JBIG2 masks; rotation must be read from pdfinfo before rasterization.
</CONSTRAINTS>
</facts>

<causal_incident at_compartment="8">

  <evidence>The failure reproduced only on rotated JBIG2-mask fixtures.</evidence>

<compartment start="138" end="146" title="Moved synonym rollout to shadow index" episode_type="infra,refactor" importance="58">
<p1>
Reworked how the Atlas search stack ships synonym changes after the last in-place reload caused a lunchtime latency spike. search/indexer/src/synonyms/reload.ts no longer patches the hot index directly; instead it builds a shadow index, loads the synonym set there, warms the query cache, and then swaps aliases. terraform/opensearch/synonym_sets.tf and docs/search/release.md were updated to treat synonym changes the same way schema promotions already work. Commit 73ce4ad.
</p1>
<p2>
Atlas search now rolls out synonym changes through a shadow-index promotion instead of mutating the live index in place. That keeps synonym updates on the same safer path as schema changes.
</p2>
<p3>
Synonym edits are now shipped by building and promoting a shadow index, not by reloading the hot one.
</p3>
<p4>products_live; products_next; shadow-index synonym rollout</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="224" end="231" title="Ledger: invoice_status column rename reversed after reporting breakage" episode_type="bug" importance="7">
<p1>
Renamed invoice_status column to status in the invoices table as cosmetic cleanup (migration 0047_rename_invoice_status.sql). Two hours later all scheduled overnight reports came back empty.

U: "why are all the reports empty this morning"

Traced to the reporting service using raw SQL with column name invoice_status — not through the ORM. Missed in review because the reporting service lives in a separate repo. Reverted via migration 0048_revert_rename.sql, commit 1f0e52a. Rename deferred until the reporting service can be updated in the same coordinated changeset.
</p1>

<compartment start="17" end="55" title="B 实施重启：回收侦察、直读 A 基础、派发 M1/M2 子道" episode_type="investigation,feature,infra" importance="62">
<p1>
exp-3（数据/架构不变量）后台任务回收，关键结论定案：成员授权撤销 = T02 `status active→revoked` + `revoked_at`（置位非删除、非 revision）；旧请求重放只定位旧 grant 返回 `GRANT_REVOKED`；重新授权须新人脸请求→新行新 grantId，`uq_grant_active` 部分唯一保证同 (account,member) 仅一条 active。绑定 = T03 行锁串行、`binding_revision` 仅真实绑/解绑递增、他人已绑→`BOUND_TO_OTHER`、代次不符→`BINDING_CHANGED`(409)、解绑须原账号 + `If-Match: binding-{revision}`。云台只见 `current_assessment_id` 指向的当前任务，恢复/轮询/旧重试不递增 `current_assessment_revision`，Worker 永不改指针。通知 = T10 创建时快照 account/binding/destination 路由代次，投递前锁外核实会话 + 短事务按 T03→T09→T10→T12 重检，不符即 cancelled；submitted≠delivered，崩溃后 unknown 走对账。成员可靠建档归 D（B 只读 T01）；推送/SMS/会话/人脸/OSS 提供方均未选定 → 明确替身 + 生产 fail-closed。

我自行核验 14 表 schema 的地面事实：`gimbals` 无 `observation_epoch/observation_seq` 列 → M2 云台心跳的 epoch/seq 必须存进 `gimbals.latest_observation` JSONB（F 形态、写时带 schema_version），从而不需要公共迁移、不碰共享 Schema；`member_access_grants.source_request_id` NOT NULL UNIQUE → 建授权必须先有 T13 行，M1-A01 必须走 A 的 IdempotencyService；`notifications.account_id` NOT NULL、`payload` 强制 schema_version、`uq_notification_dedup` 含 cancelled 行（不得靠删行重置去重键）；`notification_destinations` active ⇒ account_id+session_ref+registration 非空（DB CHECK 已强制）；stub 中属 B 的端点已逐条定位（M1×3、M2×7、M5×1），M2-A01 云台认证在 A 的 auth 控制器内接线，可方法级精准移除。

U: 用户重启后已明确"继续"——仍只在mvp-b业务树，运行文件放本树忽略的 .coordination/B-work/，不读根协调目录或服务凭据；为控制内存，只在实际测试需要时启动B专属PG55435/Web18083/worker18084，保留mvp-b-pg卷；不使用A默认55432、不启动A/E或其他包服务；原12API/统一MediaAccessPolicy边界、共享改动先报协调、真实Oracle最终SHA门禁、仅feature提交不合并推送均不变。

恢复后先查后台任务状态：Map A foundation code for B 上次已被 RequestBurstTooFast 限流打断，重试后再次触发平台突发保护失败（[47] task error，RequestBurstTooFast）。不再依赖该子任务，改为自行直读 A 基础代码完成集成映射（认证端口/PrincipalContext、MediaAccessPolicy 现状、IdempotencyService/T13 模式、worker handler 调用协议、stub 端点位置），随后完成 L1 公共接线类编辑（统一业务 MediaAccessPolicy 落位 web/mediapolicy、B 相关 stub 占位移除），并在收尾派发 L2「Implement M1 identity APIs」、L3「Implement M2 device APIs」两条实施子道（M5+handler 的 L4 待后续派发，L5 验收脚本仍按计划）。feature/mvp-identity-devices 基线 ccee6e28、门禁纪律均未变。
</p1>
<p2>
回收 exp-3 侦察定案：撤销=置位非删（active→revoked + revoked_at，重放→GRANT_REVOKED）、绑定=T03 行锁 + revision 串行（BOUND_TO_OTHER/BINDING_CHANGED）、通知=创建时路由快照 + 投递前 T03→T09→T10→T12 重检、成员建档归 D、各提供方未选→替身+fail-closed。
自核 schema：gimbals 无 epoch/seq 列 → 心跳 epoch/seq 存 latest_observation JSONB（免公共迁移）；source_request_id NOT NULL UNIQUE → M1-A01 必须先建 T13、必须走 IdempotencyService；uq_notification_dedup 含 cancelled 行不可删行重置；notification_destinations active 三字段非空由 DB CHECK 强制；stub 端点 M1×3/M2×7/M5×1 已定位。
U: "仍只在mvp-b业务树…为控制内存，只在实际测试需要时启动B专属PG55435/Web18083/worker18084，保留mvp-b-pg卷…"
Map A foundation 子任务二次 RequestBurstTooFast 失败，放弃该后台道、自行直读 A 代码完成基础映射，做 L1 公共接线编辑（MediaAccessPolicy/stub 移除），派发 Implement M1 identity APIs 与 Implement M2 device APIs 两条实施子道。
</p2>
<p3>
B 实施重启完成：exp-3 侦察定稿、schema 地面事实自核定案（gimbals 心跳 epoch/seq 走 latest_observation JSONB 免迁移、source_request_id UNIQUE 强制 M1-A01 经 IdempotencyService）。A 基础映射子任务两次 RequestBurstTooFast 限流后改为自行直读完成；完成 L1 公共接线并在最后派发 M1/M2 实现子道，进入正式实施。
</p3>
<p4>
B 重启实施；RequestBurstTooFast×2→自行直读 A 基础；gimbals latest_observation JSONB 承载心跳 epoch/seq；source_request_id UNIQUE→走 IdempotencyService
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="56" end="92" title="回收四条实施道：M1/M2/媒体策略/M5 全部落地并通过独立红线复核" episode_type="feature,investigation" importance="68">
<p1>
本窗口四条实施道全部回收，B 包三大模块+媒体策略落地，我随后做了独立红线复核（grep 级，不采信 fixer 自报）。

**M1 道回收**：`web/identity/`（FaceIdentityResolver、ResolvedFaceIdentity、DevTestFaceIdentityResolver、IdentityProvidersConfig dev/test-only 而无 prod bean、MemberAccessGrantService 474 行、MemberAccessGrantController 211 行；MemberAccessGrantsIT 660+StorageFailureIT 82，共 12 IT）。流程：严格 multipart `{metadata,face}` 验证→JCS payloadHash（capture+consent+accountUuid+installationId+face digest）→`IdempotencyService.begin`→`MediaIntakeService.ingest(GRANT_FACE)`→回读→`FaceProvider.classify`→resolver→`members` 只读查找→业务事务。MATCHED+有成员：已有 active→200 同 grantId，否则 INSERT（`source_request_id=handle.requestId()`）→201；QUALITY_REJECTED→422；DEPENDENCY_FAILED→503；UNCERTAIN/RELIABLE_NEW/库中无成员→403 FACE_NOT_VERIFIED 同一非揭示消息。重放：active→200 replayed=true、revoked→403 GRANT_REVOKED、缺失→404。`uq_grant_active` DuplicateKeyException→回滚后恢复事务复读 active 行 completeSuccess→200（并发不 500）。begin 后确定的 4xx 用 completeRejected 记录，使同键重试重放原拒绝（比 lane 字面步骤更严但合 idempotency 语义）。A02 keyset 分页 `(account_id,status,created_at DESC,id DESC)` 对齐 `idx_grants_account_status_created`，游标绑定 accountId digest 拒跨账号游标，只返回 active、省略 memberSummary。A03 行锁仅 active 置 revoked（204 无体、无 Cache-Control），已撤销不再写、revoked_at 不变。404 两分支"字节一致"仅在掩掉每次必变的契约 requestId 后成立，测试如此断言。

我的独立红线复核结论：单表/无 JOIN（唯一写是 `INSERT INTO member_access_grants` 与字段级 `UPDATE media_objects SET member_id`）；`members` 零 INSERT/UPDATE（成员建档确属 D）；撤销不复活（MemberAccessGrantService:151 对已撤销行抛 GRANT_REVOKED 不新建）；存在性不泄漏（180/186/193 三分支同一 FACE_NOT_VERIFIED_MESSAGE）；`verification_summary` 仅入 INSERT 列绝不投影（响应恰为 `{grantId,memberId,status,grantedAt}` 四字段，与契约 additionalProperties:false 一致）；T13 外键满足；payloadHash 覆盖 capture 全字段+consentEvidenceRef+installationId+accountUuid（同键不同内容必然 409）。

**M2 道回收**：`web/devices/` 2096 主 + 1366 测试行、22 IT。心跳 epoch/seq 存 `gimbals.latest_observation` JSONB（observation_epoch、observation_seq JSON integer、schema_version:1、power_state、observed_at、received_at、task_ref、execution_ref、episodes）；不同 epoch=新来源会话接受并重置，同 epoch 仅严格更大 seq；拒绝/重复→200 accepted=false、不刷 last_seen_at、不 bump status_revision、不覆盖；`status_revision` 用 `WHERE id=? AND status_revision=<锁内读值>` 守卫，仅 unknown/offline→online +1，永不写 offline；last_seen_at 取服务器 now() 非客户端 observedAt。incidentId 服务端生成、active 期间复用、清除→resolved+resolved_at、再发生→新 id。A04 观察 Idempotency-Key 必需，顺序 auth→begin（重放短路）→ConnectionProofVerifier→业务事务→T04 定位/注册（savepoint 捕 DuplicateKeyException 复读），observer_* 取自认证主体绝不取 body；字段级 UPDATE 带 `AND observation_epoch IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ?
